data.title: BUSY PHILIPPS DEBUTS FIRST-EVER PARCHMENT PAPER DRESS FROM KITCHEN BRAND 'IF YOU CARE' AS FASHION TAKES OVER NYC
data.description: At a recent event in New York, If You Care Parchment Paper showcased its performance by offering one lucky fan the opportunity to win a custom dress and a year's supply of parchment paper. data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops New Meat Marinating Machine (CTK-2235)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 14, 2026, an inventor from Laceys Spring, Alabama, discussed their innovative creation, the MEDDERS MARINATING MEAT MACHINE. This machine aims to enhance convenience by eliminating the need for repeated trips while marinating meat. data.title: HelloNation Article Featuring Roofing Expert Cody Slagle Explains the Post-Storm Roof Checklist Texoma Homeowners Should Follow
data.description: Following a severe storm in North Texas, homeowners in DENISON are advised to inspect their roof thoroughly to ensure its integrity. This involves checking shingles, gutters, flashing, and attic spaces for any signs of damage. The aftermath of a strong Texoma storm can leave roofs vulnerable, so it is crucial for homeowners to proactively assess the condition of their roofs. This article by HelloNation provides important guidelines for homeowners on how to conduct post-storm roof inspections. Taking these measures can help prevent further damage and ensure the safety of the property.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Device to Assist in Hanging Sheet Rock/Drywall (CTK-1999)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 14, 2026, an inventor from New Orleans, LA shared his creation, the HANDY MAN, aimed at simplifying the task of hanging sheet rock or drywall independently. The inventor, also a painter, recognized the need for a more efficient method and designed a solution that eliminates the necessity of seeking assistance. This invention could potentially revolutionize the construction industry and aid individuals working solo on such projects.

data.title: Lavender Appoints Two Clinical Leaders to Support Quality and Operations at Scale
data.description: The national telepsychiatry practice has recently named Kara Birch, who holds a Doctorate in Nursing Practice and certifications in Psychiatric Mental Health and Family Nurse Practice, as well as Anna Lau, with a Master of Science in Nursing and certifications in Psychiatric Mental Health and Women's Health Nurse Practice, to enhance their clinical excellence and nursing operations. The announcement was made in New York on September 14, 2026. This move comes as telepsychiatry continues to grow in providing broader access to mental health care services.

data.title: Benchmark Yield Hits 5%. How Will Stocks Respond To A Fed Rate Hike?
data.description: On Monday, the 10-year Treasury yield reached 5%, marking the first time since October 2023. There is speculation about whether the stock market will experience further declines if the Federal Reserve increases interest rates. The impact of a potential Fed rate hike on stocks is a topic of interest for investors and financial analysts alike.

data.title: Oracle Stock Falls After Ellison Scraps Plan To Sell Up To $7.5 Billion In Stock
data.description: The price of Oracle stock dropped significantly following Chairman Larry Ellison's decision to cancel his intention to sell up to $7.5 billion worth of his stake. This move led to a decline in Oracle's stock value, causing concern among investors. The decision to scrap the plan had a noticeable impact on the company's performance in the stock market.

data.title: Paradromics Achieves Real-Time Speech with Connexus® Brain-Computer Interface
data.description: In Austin, Texas, Paradromics Inc., a company specializing in neurotechnology, revealed that the initial recipient of the Connexus® BCI has effectively utilized the system for immediate speech and text interaction. This advancement occurred within the Connect-One Early Feasibility Study, carried out with FDA approval under an Investigational Device Exemption (IDE). Paradromics Inc. is focused on creating a high-data-rate brain-computer interface (BCI) platform to improve human capabilities, marking a significant achievement in the field.
